description: Porque quiero mas niñas en las tics
summary:
The last Signal is an interactive educational game that explores humanity's relationship with technology through a post-apocalyptic science fiction story. In a future where technology has consumed human civilization, forgotten machines begin reconnecting, sending signals across an abandoned world.
Inspired by NASA's exploration of space and technological innovation, The Last Signal encourages young people to think critically about our dependence on technology and imagine new possibilities for the future.
details:
The prototype was developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It also incorporates real NASA space photographs and publicly available resources as visual references for its science fiction universe.

The project's creativity lies in Its immersive narrative. Instead of learning through isolated activities, players become part of a story in which every challenge contributes to restoring a forgotten network.

During development, I considered accessibility, age-appropriate language, intuitive navigation, educational value and visual storytelling. We wanted to create an experience that is both entertaining and educational, showing that technology can be a tool for learning, creativity and connection.
